status_policy: The status field is derived by build() from the gates below; check() recomputes and compares. Missing status is fail-closed (not ready).

stages.T23a: A1 behavior-requirement classification of all 30 canonical multiblock kinds (unclassified = 0); A2 selection of 2-3 structures serving closed v1 main chains with four written criteria.
stages.T23b: B1 schema-v1 expressibility evidence for every selected structure (no aisle/repeat unless inexpressible); B2 controller plugin whitelist registry with quarantine semantics.
stages.T23c: C1 per-structure implementation (JSON, registration, models, language, recipes); C2 survival acquisition and real product consumers; C3 six lifecycle paths per structure as GameTests.
stages.T23d: D1 three-axis closeout with MEASURED worst-case load bounds; D2 chain rebuild with historical baselines untouched; D3 single clean record.

closure_policy.reason: T23 classification, selection, plugin, lifecycle, acquisition and load gates are complete; repository-wide verification is bound separately by the full snapshot report.
